propositions: Six duplicate Jira comment IDs must be identified, validated in a manifest, and deleted during a controlled quiet window while preserving six target survivor IDs and non-target comment state unchanged

The tickets git history must be rewritten to remove comment-echo material, verified by fsck and replay parity, then published to origin/tickets via exact-lease force-push with old and new tip OIDs recorded
All persistent writer clones must be replaced with the new epoch after publication, and writers must be quiesced before deletion and restored one at a time after publication with zero resurrection

Post-deletion but pre-publication state must remain auditable and never serviceable, with manifest digest, journal, bundle, and exact OLD_TIP/NEW_TIP bindings preventing deletion ambiguity and ref movement
Deployed old-epoch runtimes must refuse both stale-union paths via epoch guard, and rollback via exact-lease must reproduce OLD_TIP with strict fsck passing

Two independent production-runtime dry runs must plan zero comment/label/link operations with matching canonical plan digests, proving convergence after candidate rewrite and before writer restoration
